text:
incident-bot: Alert: sustained p95 latency >900ms for model-group rwd/open-7b-quant. Paging oncall linda at 1746001234

linda: I'm on it. Seeing dashboard spike, tail latency up and some users reporting slow responses. No errors yet.

ryan: I deployed a batching-change yesterday that adjusted micro-batching thresholds and also landed a quantization kernel tweak in the same window. Could be interaction.

tina: metrics: KV cache hit-rate dropped from ~90% -> ~60% across hosts serving rwd/open-7b-quant. Batching throughput increased but latency worse.

opsbot: Summary: p95 180ms -> 1.1s; kv_hit_ratio down ~30%. GPU mem pressure marginally higher. Linked alerts: latency-tail-1746, kv-hitdrop-1746.

linda: prioritize quick mitigation: can we force older kernel selection or disable aggressive batching while we triage? Which is lower blast radius?

mark: disabling batching heuristics per-route is fast, non-invasive. Kernel revert would require model-service restart and take longer.

ryan: note: the quant kernel introduced a new tiling strategy that changes KV cache write ordering. That might reduce prefix reuse. If that's true, reverting kernel would likely fix it, but yes higher risk.

pm-sam: flagging customer impact: support queue shows increased latency reports from 4 enterprise accounts. No SLA breaches yet but degrade UX. Will prepare notices after we have root cause.

linda: Action: disable aggressive batching at route layer to reduce tail and validate. Mark, can you roll that config? Ryan, prepare revert artifact but hold.

mark: running config change: `rwd-routerctl set batching.aggressive.rwd/open-7b-quant=false --env prod`
deploy-bot: Change 90321 initiated by mark. Rolling to 25% of routing clusters now.

mark: 25% done. Observing p95 in those clusters -> down from 1.1s to 400ms. KV hit ratio marginally improved there.

opsbot: Noted: rollout effect visible. Recommend gradual rollout if metrics hold.

linda: proceed to 100% but do canary steps.

mark: rolled to 100% at 1746001800. Monitoring.

opsbot: Global p95 stabilized ~260ms. KV hit-rate recovered to ~83%.

ryan: confirms: disabling aggressive batching reduced concurrency pressure and allowed the cache to be more effective. Still think kernel tiling change made access patterns worse under previous batching regime.

linda: good mitigation. Now capture follow-ups and schedule postmortem. Proposed owners:
- Postmortem doc & timeline (owner: linda) - draft in 24h
- Reproduce in staging with traffic replay and kernel variations (owner: ryan) - reproducibility test in 3 days
- Add per-model KV layout metrics and a fingerprint to detect layout drift (owner: ryan) - 1 week
- Canary expansion: include p95 and kv-hit assertions post-deploy (owner: mark) - 5 days
- Automate safe rollback path for quant kernel changes (owner: eng-runtime) - 2 weeks
- Alerting: add kv-hit-rate synthetic probe and new playbook (owner: tina) - 48h
- Customer comms draft (owner: pm-sam + support) - initial outreach in 24h

pm-sam: will prioritize templated outreach for affected customers; need incident doc with affected time window and list of clusters.

ryan: I will open PR for kernel revert artifact and test runbook for safe revert. Also I'll add instrumentation hooks to export per-host kv_fingerprint metric.

tina: opening alert PR now: `infra-alerts/kv-hit-synthetic`. Will include runbook to check kv_hit<70% for >5min.

infrabot: Incident ticket created INC-2026-825 linked to alerts. Severity: P2. Playbook link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-825

linda: quick handoff: I'm on duty for another 45 minutes. After that, ryan will be primary for the follow-ups. Keep channel updated.

mark: small suggestion for postmortem: include a section on pre-deploy microbench for any kernel change that measures kv reuse under synthetic prefix workloads.

linda: agree. Adding that as a concrete action in the doc.

opsbot: Change audit log: CH-9145 (batching disable), PR-5910 (kernel revert draft).

ryan: I'll run a staging replay with both batching-enabled + new kernel and batching-disabled + new kernel to isolate interaction. Expect results in ~6h.

pm-sam: support will delay outbound customer notifications until doc draft is ready; will notify top impacted customers proactively once confirmed.

linda: checklist before I handoff:
- [x] aggressive batching disabled global at 1746001800
- [x] p95 returned near baseline
- [ ] postmortem draft (linda) - in progress
- [ ] kv-hit synthetic alert (tina) - PR open
- [ ] kernel revert PR (ryan) - draft
- [ ] instrumentation for kv layout fingerprints (ryan) - planned
- [ ] canary checks (mark) - planned

linda: paging quiet. I'll ping again at 1746004800 for status check. If regressions occur, page me immediately.

ryan: ack. I'll post the replay results and link to the PR here when ready.

pm-sam: drafting customer template and will attach logs & timeframe.

linda: scheduling postmortem meeting: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/pm-INC-2026-825 at 1746080000. Owner: linda.

opsbot: Note: mitigation steps recorded. Suggested postmortem topics: deploy testing gaps, canary coverage, alerting, kernel change process.

mark: will prepare canary job `kv-reuse-check` to run after kernel changes.

infrabot: Auto-note: next steps ticket assignments created in tracker.

linda: thanks everyone. Handing off to ryan for remediation work. Closing active page.
